verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page claims a first-party AI feature, "Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead," which is AI working on the customer's own financial data inside the product. That is a single thin marketing line. The other insight claims (strategic insights, finding wasted spend) come from human CFOs and accountants, not AI. missing for 10: documentation of how the AI feature works in the portal, AI-generated proactive insights or suggestions beyond Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead
